description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class 'UserAlreadyRegisteredException' which extends a global exception class. It is used in the context of a finance or banking application to signal an attempt to register a user who is already registered.

classes.name: UserAlreadyRegisteredException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating the user is already registered, extending the application's global exception handling class.
